六重檐高阁及正面石台阶

prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes.  SUBJECT: the DACHENGGE (Hall of Mahayana) of PUNING TEMPLE, Chengde, Qing 1755–1758. Image 2 is a clear actual south-front photograph and defines full silhouette; image 3 shows the same hall at slight angle for roof structure only. Draw ONLY the tall central main hall and its stone platform, not the distant little Tibetan towers, side shrines or walls. This is a stepped square block with SIX roof/eave levels, counted along the central front axis from the lowest projecting porch roof to the highest little central roof. Their spacing is uneven: lowest entry porch, then a closely paired double eave across broad middle body, then another intermediate eave, then the upper corner pavilion level and finally a higher central pavilion roof. Carefully follow the real photograph, not a regular pagoda. Four corner roofs and a raised central roof crown the top, with vase finials (three visibly prominent from the front). Rectangular tiered timber-and-plaster masses, wide rows of rectangular windows, five central entry bays below lowest eave, huge end pilasters. Preserve full stone terrace, railings and THREE frontal stair flights as visible; remove modern incense burner/planters/signs. Landscape 1536x1024, near straight-on complete silhouette, balanced whitespace. Windows white outlined with sparse lattice hints. Fine thin contours and almost blank roof planes, no full tile grid, no dark shadow.

site_recommendation.name: 普宁寺
site_recommendation.yearNote: 汉藏建筑群一条，不另拆大佛；大乘阁为代表。
site_recommendation.lede: 大乘阁在六重檐与层层收分之间容纳巨大的千手千眼观音，将汉藏佛寺形制汇在同一座高阁。

facts.label: 年代
facts.text: 普宁寺建于乾隆二十年至二十三年（1755—1758），大乘阁为后部核心建筑。

facts.label: 形制
facts.text: 大乘阁外观六重檐，顶部由中央与四角屋顶组成，形成中央高起、四角拱卫的轮廓。

facts.label: 观音
facts.text: 阁内供奉大型木雕千手千眼观音，建筑高度、层间结构与内部造像共同组织空间。

quality_check.notes: 实拍与输出已查看，六层檐线逐项对应，顶部中央及两侧可见宝瓶、完整台基和三梯保留。
